Nina Rao: Heads-up — sporadic tail-latency blips in prod-us-central since 02:12 UTC. low-volume but customer-visible. proposing v2.2.0-hotfix (kv prefetch off-by-one). can we squeeze a hotfix into 02:20-02:30 UTC slot?
Ethan Brooks: artifact name and quick risk summary?
Nina Rao: artifact: v2.2.0-hotfix. tiny diff, CI green, unit+integration passed. risk: touches cache hot path only.
Liu Wei: ops: we can allow a one-shot canary-skip for this short window if QA certs finish within 6m and we pin to us-hotfix pool for at least 30m.
QA Runner: running smoke + perf now, ETA ~5m. will ping when done.
DeployBot: deploybot: queued rollout r-infer/embed-service v2.2.0-hotfix -> prod-us-central (6 pods). canary=false (requested). run_id=deploy-6578901110. details: https://internal/redwood/deploys/6578901110
Nina Rao: if QA approves, plan: pin to us-hotfix, route progressive traffic, monitor 95p and errors for 10m. rollback triggers: error-rate >0.6% OR 95p latency regression >200ms sustained 4m.
Ethan Brooks: quick vote: any objections to canary-skip? speak now.
QA Runner: smoke ok, perf quick-check: 95p improves ~80ms. no correctness regressions. :thumbsup:
Liu Wei: ops ack: one-shot canary-skip allowed. applying pin after deploy starts. rollback playbook: https://internal/redwood/runbooks/embed-rollback.md
DeployBot: deploybot: rollout started (0/6 ready). healthcheck=/live expecting 200.
Nina Rao: applying monitoring overlays (trace sampling up, synthetic checks). if we see 502 >1% for 2m, trigger rollback.
DeployBot: deploybot: rollout progress 4/6 ready. no health failures.
Ethan Brooks: prepping rollback command just in case: `trafficctl rollback --service embed-service --to v2.1.9 --run deploy-6578901110 --reason "auto-rollback"`
OpsBot: opsbot: pin applied to pool us-hotfix. LB propagation to 4 edges confirmed.
DeployBot: deploybot: rollout complete (6/6 ready). run_id=deploy-6578901110. new version receiving live traffic.
QA Runner: 8m watch: initial warmup spike at ~70s but stable after 3m, no error uptick. LGTM.
Liu Wei: leaving pin for 45m as agreed, then auto-unpin. command queued: `trafficctl unpin --after 45m --pool us-hotfix --service embed-service`
Nina Rao: release-notes draft (for #release-notes): "embed-service v2.2.0-hotfix — fixes kv prefetch off-by-one that caused rare tail latency spikes. Deployed to prod-us-central 02:20-02:30 UTC; QA passed; pinned to us-hotfix pool for 45m. Rollback criteria defined."
Ethan Brooks: I'll post notes after 20m watch. good job team. closing thread & filing follow-up to instrument prefetch metrics. :white_check_mark:
